en: A black‑and‑white street scene showing a cobblestone road lined with multi‑story stone buildings on the left and a tall wooden fence on the right. Several pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the sidewalks, and a horse‑drawn cart can be seen further down the street. Mature trees form an alley in the middle distance. In the background rises a tall church tower with a slender spire, dominating the skyline. At the top center of the card, a handwritten number "4528" appears.
